By color, the quipu is separated in 25 groups. The first group is 12 pendants. Then there are 24 groups alternating in color pattern. Basically the pattern is a group of 8 pendants color W, followed by a group of 9 pendants colored RB, 7 DB, RB. (The exceptions to the pattern are: groups 3,5 and 17 each have an additional pendant between positions 1 and 2; groups 5, 7 and 9 each have an additional pendant between positions 8 and 9; in groups 7 and 9, position 4 is non-existant; and in group 7, position 2 is also non-existant.) Starting with group 4, all groups of W pendants are of value 0 (or blank) and, in the alternate groups, all values in positions 1, 2 and 4 are 0 (or blank). 4. a) The values in group 3
